preconditions.description: The length of the string is between 1 and 200,000.
The number of operations is between 1 and 200,000.
The range of each operation is within the bounds of the string.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n - sum(len(c for _ in range(l, r + 1) if s[i - 1] == c))
postconditions.description: The output string length is the original length minus the number of removed characters.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == s[i] for i in range(n) if not any(l <= i + 1 <= r and s[i] == c for l, r, c in operations))
postconditions.description: The output string contains only characters not removed by any operation.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] != output[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if any(l <= i + 1 <= r and s[i] == c for l, r, c in operations) and any(l <= j + 1 <= r and s[j] == c for l, r, c in operations))
postconditions.description: The output string has no two characters swapped by the operations.
